import sys

def main():
    v = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    cand = [0] * 17
    cand[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, 17):
        cand[i] = cand[i-1] * 10 + 1

    def rec(ind, val):
        val = abs(val)
        if ind == 0:
            return val
        a1 = val // cand[ind]
        a2 = a1 + 1
        return min(a1 * (ind + 1) + rec(ind - 1, val - a1 * cand[ind]),
                   a2 * (ind + 1) + rec(ind - 1, val - a2 * cand[ind]))

    print(rec(16, v))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
